# ClipboardController

> Handles keyboard-driven cut/copy/paste operations on selected items, dispatching `ui-clip`.

## Constructor

```ts
new ClipboardController(host: HTMLElement, options?: ClipboardOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | yes |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-clip-copy` | `{ items, data }` |
| `ui-clip-cut` | `{ items, data }` |
| `ui-clip-paste` | `{ data }` |

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `destroy()` |
| `serialize()` |
| `deserialize()` |
| `cancelCut()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { ClipboardController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new ClipboardController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
